text:
sierra: Hey team — product confirmed the v1 shutdown window. We need a short, copy-light migration one-pager that SDKs and support can link to. Must cover: param rename (model_id -> model), embed dim mismatch troubleshooting, streaming callback change, and where legacy snippets live. Aim: <300 words.

paul: I'll take the JS/TS bullet and the streaming examples. Plan: show before/after for streaming and include a note about callback shape `{ event, chunk }`.

anne: I'll author the Python bullets and the embed-dim troubleshooting steps. Proposing a tiny checklist: 1) check embed_dim, 2) try compat model id, 3) contact support with vector sample.

docs-bot: Editorial freeze reminder: 48 hours before scheduled deprecation notice. Also add `docs/compat` label to PRs to trigger the preview.

paul: Draft snippet for param rename + shim toggle: ```js
// v1
client.generate({ model_id: "rwd-small-2025", prompt: "Hello" })
// v2
client.generate({ model: "rwd-small-2025", input: "Hello" })
// docs shim (example)
const client = new RedwoodClient({ featureFlags: ["docs.v1_compat_shim"] })
```

anne: Python embed check snippet for one-pager: ```py
vec = embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-v2", input=text)
if len(vec) != expected_dim:
    # fallback: call compat model or re-embed with older model id
    vec = embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-compat", input=text)
```

sdk-eng: Note: the shim translates parameter names but does NOT convert or reproject embedding vectors or rewrite semantics (e.g., changes to top_k behavior). Call this out clearly.

mobile-eng: Mobile quickstart needs a 1-line perf note about higher-dim embeddings adding ~100-200ms cold-start on some devices; suggest prewarm on app start as mitigation. I'll add the snippet.

paul: Streaming migration example (before/after) will be in the one-pager; I'll keep it minimal. Also adding a link to full migration guide for edge cases.

anne: I'll also add a single troubleshooting flow for 422 errors after swap: check request path, inspect embed_dim, try compat model id, collect diagnostic payload and open a support ticket.

qa-bot: Quick checklist created: [ ] one-pager draft, [ ] JS snippets, [ ] Py snippets, [ ] mobile blurb, [ ] preview build green.

paul: Pushing PR to docs repo now, tagging `docs/compat` and `preview/ready`. PR will include a small banner snippet for legacy pages.

(brief pause)

docs-bot: Preview build triggered. Expect link in comments when ready.

qa-bot: Preview build green. Smoke test results: all snippets render; streaming example needs a tiny wording tweak but functions. Marked `impact/low`.

anne: One-pager added and linked in SDK changelogs. Short copy: what changed, quick fixes, links: full migration guide, legacy snippets, support. Kept it to ~220 words.

paul: Banner added to legacy folder: "Deprecated — v1 will be turned off on 2026-04-20. See migration one-pager."

sdk-eng: Added changelog note in SDK repos: "Breaking: model_id->model; shim available only until 2026-05-20."

mobile-eng: Mobile prewarm snippet merged into quickstart.

docs-bot: Automation note: schedule deprecation notice email 72 hours before sunset and attach one-pager link.

sierra: Great work. Closing out once support confirms canned response copy includes one-pager link. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
